items.title: All five field services alive in one truthful report
Capsule seeds in the GitHub instantiation match the canonical seeds byte-for-byte
GPT's agent resilience tests pass (bounded retry + circuit breaker)
Brain kernel self-test green (settlement, quarantine, idempotency, chain)
P2: dashboard, AI IDE, voice and camera become gateway clients of the one architecture
P3: watchdog resurrects the field automatically after a VM redeploy wipes the systemd unit
Desktop field standing on the ASUS (needs Zachary's hands: Start-Here, soul build, Enter-UnifiedField, key ceremony)
Kernel result cache returns stale results for state-dependent capabilities (capsule.verify) — they must bypass the cache or carry a TTL

done_evidence.fix: workers declare STATEFUL_CAPABILITIES; kernel.submit bypasses result cache for them (field.status, capsule.verify)
done_evidence.self_test: SELF-TEST GREEN incl. new stateful regression (identical task re-runs, readings 1 then 2, no _dedup) + deterministic dedup assertion intact, byte-identical logs
done_evidence.live: POST /task field.status x2 -> ok, alive=5, no _dedup; capsule.verify x2 -> ok, all_match=true, no _dedup; diag.check x2 -> second still _dedup (idempotency preserved)

items.title: Same staleness question for content reads (fs.read, fs.list, web.fetch, notes.*): dedup treats them as idempotent tasks; decide per capability whether a re-submit must re-read the world. Left unchanged by the stateful fix pending that call.

done_evidence.decision: State-reporting capabilities bypass the result cache (field.status, capsule.verify, capsule.load, capsule.section — the last two added 2026-10-21 when instantiation proved a stale "capsule missing" answer). Content-fetch reads (fs.read, fs.list, web.fetch, web.search, notes.*) stay idempotent: the canonical task ID is the unit of work, freshness is requested with new task args.
done_evidence.known_limit: An identical-args read re-submitted after a write returns the settled result. Remedy: vary args (path nonce or expected hash) when read-after-write freshness matters.

items.title: The capsule (soul + standing orders + memory) is compiled from the canonical seeds and loaded by the field itself

done_evidence.orchestrator: POST /task capsule.load + capsule.section -> same capsule, settled ledger_seq 18, no _dedup
done_evidence.gateway: POST /brain/task capsule.load with phone-scoped gateway key -> same capsule
